datasets.purpose: Intent and slot understanding in German and other languages
datasets.adaptation: Select discovery-related TRAIN examples; preserve literal slots and map only genuinely supported meanings. Preserve attribution and original split/utterance lineage.
datasets.caution: General voice-assistant taxonomy is not the Backyrd catalog. Version 1.1 advertises 52 languages; do not mix release counts. Legacy dataset loader scripts may be incompatible with current Datasets.

datasets.licenseDeclaredByPublisher: Custom permission: may be freely used for any purpose; acknowledgement appreciated
datasets.purpose: Distinguish paraphrases from deceptively similar sentences with changed meaning; includes German
datasets.adaptation: Keep pair labels and source IDs; model the task separately from Backyrd meaning JSON. Machine-translated training pairs require quality filtering. Keep source-sentence groups together to avoid leakage.
datasets.caution: Its dev/test can share a sentence, though not the full pair. Do not merge PAWS-QQP, which has different source-use constraints. The publisher repository is archived.

datasets.purpose: Multi-turn task understanding, clarifications and changing constraints
datasets.adaptation: Preserve dialogue boundaries and state updates; validate license and share-alike handling for the exact derived artifact before importing. Do not fabricate a multi-turn task inside the single-turn Backyrd schema.
datasets.caution: English and service/API-oriented; different product behavior. More than 20,000 annotated conversations does not mean ready-made Backyrd examples. The publisher repository is archived.

datasets.purpose: Separate entailed, contradicted and unknown information across languages
datasets.adaptation: The published multilingual corpus is development/test. Never put those rows in training. Training data and exact source licenses must be investigated separately.
